definitions.full: H4329. mesak [ מוּסָךְ ] noun masculine architectural term (si vera lectio) of some covered structure, otherwise unknown; — only construct מוּסַחהַֿשַּׁכָּת 2Kin 16:18 Qr (Kt מיסך i.e. מֵיסַךְ ); — ᵐ5 τὸν θεμέλιον τῆς καθέδρας , i.e. הַשֶּׁבֶת מוּסַד ?
